eligibility.geography: validated unchanged boundary regime and election-local seat number; never seat-name-only
eligibility.maori: separate coverage/abstention; no general pooled rule silently applied

allowedTargetInputs: independently published local valid party-vote group counts
observed votes cast and ballot-validity controls if explicitly declared
official post-election candidature for retrospective mapping

as_of_forecast.cutoff: source-pinned official nomination-close timestamp, currently missing
as_of_forecast.missingRequiredInput: abstain or provide explicitly wide bounds
as_of_forecast.forecastClaim: only if every required input passes cutoff audit

ballotAccounting.sourcePopulation: all cast ballots in an electorate, with processed split rows covering valid plus informal party ballots where available
destinations: no valid candidate vote including party-vote-only or candidate-disallowed
ballotAccounting.massEquation: votesCast = sum(groupMass); for each group, sum(destinationRouteFraction)=1; validCandidateVotes = sum(namedCandidateDestinationVotes)
ballotAccounting.unmatchedMass: explicit feasible routing set across all destinations, never zero or a hidden renormalization
ballotAccounting.publishedSplitCellUnit: rounded percent conditional on party-ballot row; count is unavailable
ballotAccounting.candidateShareDenominator: valid candidate votes, not valid party votes or total split rows
ballotAccounting.zeroPossibleDenominator: undefined candidate share and point abstention
ballotAccounting.jointConstraint: candidate marginal lower/upper bounds are projections of one shared feasible contest ledger, not independently simultaneous endpoints
ballotAccounting.candidateShareBounds: joint candidate-vote / valid-candidate-denominator extrema, never independent endpoint division
ballotAccounting.partyGroupInputConservation: sum of every valid party group, informal party and disallowed/unrepresented remainder equals votes cast; reject or bound inconsistent transformed share vectors, no hidden renormalization
